t: Zero-Sum Attention, Sovereign Tools: Hardening the GAPalyzer and Your Codebase
s: This article details the hardening of GAPalyzer, a competitor content gap analysis tool crucial for SEO, framed within the philosophy of building self-sovereign tools. It explores an iterative, text-centric development journey to refine Jupyter Notebooks for porting to web apps, managing complexity and data privacy.
sub: GAPalyzer: From Jupyter Notebook to Web App
Sanitizing Notebooks & Managing Client-Specific Data Leaks
